ruling.recommended_action: Refund $2.40 (1.70 km of unbilled detour on the metered RydeTAXI fare) as a Ryde voucher, and record the driver's RD-1 violation for route deviation; send the driver's account for review (RD-6).

segment_findings.reason: Rider's stop request at Clementi Mall [F9] with driver's advance agreement [F10] is an exempt stop request under RD-3(a)/RD-5, so the 4 min dwell is the rider's request (metered waiting per RD-3(c)). However the route change itself has no reasonable cause: F15 records no traffic incident on the optimal route, so RD-4(a) is not met; F13/F14 are only speed-band records and per RD-4(b) cannot exempt on their own (and neither lies on the substituted optimal segment); F16 light rain is not a reasonable cause. The segment is therefore unexempted under RD-1/RD-4(c) and its 1.70 km extra is refundable.

rejected_claims.reason: 4 min metered waiting time on a RydeTAXI trip is chargeable on the meter and non-refundable per RD-3(c); it is not the $5 pick-up waiting fee of NS-6.
No surge was applied (1.0×), so the fare increase cannot be attributed to surge.
Platform fee $1.47 is a published additional charge under FARE-1 and is not refundable.
Driver's post-trip statement that the rider asked for the stop is consistent with the chat [F9], which is itself in evidence; the statement is not relied on for any consent beyond the chat.
